svg.title: What runs where
svg.desc: One lookup, top to bottom. In your browser: 01 place, 02 passes (SGP4 over 7 days in Web Workers), 03 photos (archive search matched to passes), 04 pixels (toning and the cloud at your spot), 05 share. Beside each step, the service it talks to: Photon for place names, CelesTrak element sets refreshed every 6 hours by GitHub Actions, Microsoft Planetary Computer, Element 84 and NASA GIBS for the archive search, Planetary Computer for each crop and its cloud mask, and Vercel and Supabase for the share card and link.
